summary.method: Only current taxonomy IDs and first-party manufacturer sources were used. Low-confidence or taxonomy-gap items remain unresolved.

groups.pattern: Matchmaker MC Opal / Opal Lustre powders
groups.evidence: Official Matchmaker MC manual identifies Opal Colours and Opal Lustre Enamels as ceramic powders used in ceramic build-up and firing.

groups.pattern: Matchmaker Zr stain kit and stain powders
groups.evidence: Official Matchmaker brochure describes Matchmaker CTE Stains for the ALX/Zr ceramic systems and states they may be applied internally or externally; ceramic-material is used because the current dictionary has no neutral stain category.

groups.pattern: Matchmaker Zr veneering ceramic components and shade kits
groups.evidence: Official Matchmaker Zr manual documents dentine, enamel, colour translucent, opal translucent, opacious dentine, liners, gingival, mamelon, fluorescent and related powders as components of a zirconia veneering ceramic system.
The official Zr system manual separates firing powders from their working liquids; the SKU name explicitly identifies Stain Liquid. process-liquid is the closest current non-material consumable ID.

groups.pattern: Cascom casting-machine crucibles, rings, formers, stands, tongs and service components
groups.evidence: DENKEN official casting-machine parts page identifies carbon/ceramic crucibles, crucible rings and related items as casting-machine-related implements; machine switch, fan and viewing glass remain in this accessory family at medium confidence.

groups.pattern: DH Print Provisional CB / Cast / Model resins
groups.evidence: DENKEN official release lists all three as 3D-printer materials; individual official pages identify Provisional CB as crown resin, Cast as pattern resin and Model as resin model material.
DENKEN official Master Plus page gives DDP-40 electrical, dimensions and pumping specifications and explicitly calls it a dry vacuum pump.

groups.pattern: Wax Master II electric waxing instrument
groups.evidence: DENKEN official page identifies Wax Master II model DP-2000 as an electric wax-up instrument with controller and heated pens.

DENKEN official Blaster page describes a powered automatic sandblasting unit for removing investment and oxide film; the internal generic name does not expose the exact factory model, so confidence is medium.
DENKEN official download center classifies the Zircom product family under Zirconia Sintering Furnace. The exact historical HS suffix is not exposed on the current page, so confidence is medium.

groups.pattern: American Eagle Gracey / Double Gracey XP periodontal instruments
groups.evidence: Official American Eagle instrument guide maps AEGA and AEDG codes to Gracey and Double Gracey curettes; these are reusable periodontal hand instruments. Exact code evidence also exists on the current Young Innovations product pages.
GC official product page identifies item 001573 as a reusable material dispenser for GC Paste Pak cartridges.

groups.pattern: GC Fujirock EP Type 4 dental stone
groups.evidence: GC official page identifies Fujirock EP as Type 4 dental stone for accurate laboratory models and dies. investment-gypsum is the closest existing gypsum/material taxonomy ID, although its ID name is broader than model stone.
